results.prediction: Iran war ceasefire or major escalation
results.description: The Iran-US conflict remains active with mixed diplomatic signals. Iran has rejected the US 15-point ceasefire proposal and issued its own counterproposal demanding reparations and sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. While Trump claims negotiations are ongoing and has paused attacks on Iran's energy plants, Iranian officials deny direct talks are taking place, calling US proposals "one-sided and unfair."

results.prediction: Strait of Hormuz full shipping restoration
results.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed to most commercial shipping since March 1, 2026, with Iran maintaining control through mines, missiles, and selective passage permissions. While Iran has allowed a small number of vessels to pass (primarily Chinese, Indian, Pakistani, and Malaysian-flagged ships), approximately 2,000 ships from other nations remain stranded and tanker traffic has dropped by 70%. Full shipping restoration has not been achieved.

results.prediction: Oracle Stargate financial restructuring or default
results.description: Oracle is undergoing significant financial stress related to AI infrastructure investments including Stargate. The company has taken on $58 billion in new debt over two months in 2026, implemented a $2.1 billion restructuring plan with layoffs of up to 30,000 employees, and faces multiple securities class action lawsuits. Credit default swap spreads have hit record highs at 198.18 basis points with $120 billion in outstanding debt, and Blue Owl pulled out of the Stargate deal due to concerns about Oracle's spending commitments and rising debt levels.
